# Naturasil Tinea Versicolor Treatment Soap With 10% Sulfur

Naturasil Tinea Versicolor Treatment Soap adds a 10% sulfur cleanser to your daily shower. Rated 4.3 stars by over 2,000 shoppers, this 113-gram bar helps cleanse skin, relieve itching and discomfort, and address discoloration.

## Care That Fits Your Shower Routine

Use the soap at least twice a day. Lather it, let it rest on your skin for a few minutes, then rinse. Consistent use may help spots fade over several weeks. The formula also helps relieve candida and onychomycosis, so it supports more than one concern.

## Get the Most From Each Treatment

Dry off completely, then apply Naturasil Liquid Treatment or Relief Lotion to the affected area. Spend time in the sun afterward to help restore your natural skin tone. Remove jewelry before use.

## Use It Safely

Perform a skin tolerability test before your first use. Stop use if irritation occurs, especially if you know you're sensitive to sulfur or sulfa-based products.

## Start Your Routine Today

Add Naturasil Tinea Versicolor Treatment Soap to your cart and bring a consistent, targeted cleanse into your everyday routine.
